**__The SpicyChat Creator's Guide: Visual Markdown & Hidden HUDs__**

##########
# PART ONE #
##########
*(Part 1: Visual UI Tricks & Styling)*

Most bot creators only use basic **bold** and *italics*. But SpicyChat’s frontend supports formatting tricks that let you create retro terminal screens, floating menus, and bright system alerts.

---

### **1. Yellow Floating Callout Banners**
* **The Trick:** Wrap text in single backticks (`` `text` ``)[span_0](start_span)[span_0](end_span).
* **What SpicyChat Does:** Renders text inside backticks as **high-contrast, bright yellow callout boxes** instead of plain monospace text[span_1](start_span)[span_1](end_span).
* **Why Use It:** Makes system notices, rules, and commands pop off dark mode like a floating video game HUD[span_2](start_span)[span_2](end_span).
* **How to Write It:**
`[SYSTEM NOTICE]`
`• Commands: Type /menu or /status to inspect your character.`

---

### **2. The Clean Underline Heading**
* **The Trick:** Type a bold title, then put a single hyphen `-` directly underneath on the next line.
* **What SpicyChat Does:** Creates a clean title with an automatic divider line beneath it without blowing up into giant `#` headers.
* **How to Write It:**
**Welcome to the Game Engine.**
-

---

### **3. Terminal Boot-Up Sequences**
* **The Trick:** Stack short, all-caps phrases in italics (`*...*`).
* **What SpicyChat Does:** Displays slanted system text that feels like a sci-fi console or neural-link connecting.
* **How to Write It:**
*SYSTEM INITIALIZING...*
*CONNECTING TO SERVER...*
*CORE ENGINE: ONLINE.*

---

### **4. In-Game "Slash Commands"**
* **The Trick:** Tell players to use commands like `/menu`, `/status`, or `/help "question"`[span_3](start_span)[span_3](end_span).
* **What SpicyChat Does:** Signals to the AI that these words are functional system triggers, not roleplay dialogue[span_4](start_span)[span_4](end_span).

messages.author: Bluhdwulf
messages.content:
##########
# PART TWO #
##########

**__The SpicyChat Creator's Guide: Visual Markdown & Hidden HUDs__**
*(Part 2: The Invisible HUD Trick)*

Tired of RPG bots forgetting your inventory, location, or health after 50 turns[span_5](start_span)[span_5](end_span)? You can make the bot maintain an invisible background save-file using **standard HTML comments** (`<!--` and `-->`)[span_6](start_span)[span_6](end_span).

---

### **1. How It Works (Screen vs. Brain)**
* **What You See (The Screen):** SpicyChat displays text using Markdown[span_7](start_span)[span_7](end_span). When Markdown sees `<!--` and `-->`, it treats the text as developer notes and **completely hides it from the player's screen**[span_8](start_span)[span_8](end_span). Your chat stays 100% clean story text[span_9](start_span)[span_9](end_span).
* **What the Bot Sees (The Brain):** The AI does not look at styled screens; it reads raw text[span_10](start_span)[span_10](end_span). It sees every single word, number, and stat inside that hidden comment[span_11](start_span)[span_11](end_span)!
* **The Result:** The bot updates its numbers behind the scenes on every turn, giving it a permanent memory anchor without cluttering your chat with ugly stat boxes[span_12](start_span)[span_12](end_span).

---

### **2. Why This Kills Bot Amnesia**
As a roleplay grows past 50 messages, earlier turns get pushed out of the AI’s memory window[span_13](start_span)[span_13](end_span). If you found a rare potion 30 messages ago, the bot forgets you have it.

By having the bot update a hidden comment on every turn, it leaves a silent save file in its immediate memory buffer[span_14](start_span)[span_14](end_span):

messages.author: Bluhdwulf
messages.content:
1. The bot reads its own hidden note from the previous turn[span_15](start_span)[span_15](end_span).
2. It updates your stats based on whatever just happened in the story[span_16](start_span)[span_16](end_span).
3. It prints a fresh hidden note at the start or end of its reply[span_17](start_span)[span_17](end_span).
4. The cycle repeats forever with zero memory loss[span_18](start_span)[span_18](end_span)!

messages.author: Bluhdwulf
messages.content:
###########
# PART THREE #
###########
**__The SpicyChat Creator's Guide: Visual Markdown & Hidden HUDs__**
*(Part 3: Custom Setup & The 4 Golden Rules)*

You don't need coding knowledge to build a tracker[span_19](start_span)[span_19](end_span). Pick the stats you want to track, keep labels short, and give your bot an instruction in its **Personality** box[span_20](start_span)[span_20](end_span):

> *"Update and output this hidden state tag on every response based on story events[span_21](start_span)[span_21](end_span):*
> `<!-- [STATE: LOC:Town | HP:100 | GOLD:50 | GEAR:IronSword] -->`[span_22](start_span)"[span_22](end_span)

---

### **The 4 Golden Rules for SpicyChat**
If you skip these platform rules, your hidden tracker will break[span_23](start_span)[span_23](end_span):

1. **Always Anchor Turn 0 (The Greeting):**
   * LLMs copy patterns from chat history[span_24](start_span)[span_24](end_span). If your bot's **First Message (Greeting)** does not already have a starter comment tag placed at the bottom, the bot will usually ignore your system prompt[span_25](start_span)[span_25](end_span)! Always paste your starting tag at the end of your greeting[span_26](start_span)[span_26](end_span).
2. **Keep Comments on ONE Single Line:**
   * HTML comments must be strictly continuous[span_27](start_span)[span_27](end_span). If you hit Enter and split your tag across multiple lines, SpicyChat’s markdown renderer can break and leak your hidden code into visible text[span_28](start_span)[span_28](end_span).
3. **Respect the 300-Token Output Limit:**
   * SpicyChat models have tight generation limits (often 180–300 tokens)[span_29](start_span)[span_29](end_span). Keep your hidden tags short and simple so the bot doesn't run out of room and cut off mid-sentence[span_30](start_span)[span_30](end_span).

messages.author: Bluhdwulf
messages.content:
4. **The Voice / TTS Quirk:**
   * If a player taps the **Voice** speaker button, SpicyChat’s audio engine reads raw message text[span_31](start_span)[span_31](end_span). That means **the voice will read hidden HTML tags out loud**[span_32](start_span)[span_32](end_span)! Keep state tags lean or warn audio users[span_33](start_span)[span_33](end_span).

##########
# PART FOUR #
##########

**__The SpicyChat Creator's Guide: Visual Markdown & Hidden HUDs__**
*(Part 4: Production-Ready Starter Greeting)*

Here is how all these styling tricks, floating yellow banners, and the invisible state anchor look when combined into a ready-to-use bot greeting. Copy and adapt it for your own RPG bots!

---

### **Copy-Paste Starter Greeting Template**

*SYSTEM INITIALIZING...*
*CONNECTING TO SERVER...*
*CORE SIMULATION: ONLINE.*

**Welcome to the Living RPG Engine.**
-
Step into an open-ended world where your choices, survival skills, and combat tactics dictate your fate.

`[SYSTEM NOTICE]`
`• Passive Tracking: HP, Currency, and Inventory track silently in the background.`
`• Commands: Type /menu or /status anytime to inspect your character sheet.`
`• Assistance: Type /help "question" for direct system support.`

To initialize your character and enter the world, declare:
1. **Character Name:**
2. **Class / Role:**
3. **Starting Gear:**

*Declare your details to begin.*
<!-- [STATE: LOC:StartingVillage | HP:100 | GOLD:50 | GEAR:StarterKit] -->

---

### **Quick Setup Checklist**
1. Paste your rules and state instructions into the **Personality** box[span_34](start_span)[span_34](end_span).
2. Paste this template into the **First Message (Greeting)** box[span_35](start_span)[span_35](end_span).
3. Make sure the hidden `<!-- [STATE:...] -->` tag sits at the very bottom of the greeting so the bot has a pattern to copy on Turn 1[span_36](start_span)[span_36](end_span)!
